Fix row pairs and use nonnegative sliding-window counts over columns; transpose to square the smaller dimension.

Selecting a currently required character immediately is dominance-safe: moving first can always be deferred until after the same selection, with no benefit lost.

targets.review_note: Enumerate palindromes downward by mirroring the leading half. Even-length palindromes are divisible by11, leaving only11 as prime. Exact deterministic Miller-Rabin bases cover unsigned64-bit values; beyond that use witness filtering followed by exact trial division rather than silently extending the deterministic guarantee. Inputs are stated positive at least2. Public regression fixes the transition from exhausted3-digit palindromes to exceptional even palindrome11.

targets.review_note: For each possible final digit, digitwise multiplication determines all remaining digits uniquely: each product digit equals the next original digit under rotation. Carry must close exactly into the chosen last digit, with no leading zero and no overflow. Compare valid same-length strings lexically. Linear output-sized work avoids constructing million-digit integers.

targets.review_note: Normal-play Nim is losing exactly when all pile sizes XOR to0. Walsh-Hadamard transform diagonalizes XOR convolution; independent identically distributed piles raise each transformed coefficient to powern. The zero component is their mean, so subtract from1. Pad to next power of2 and only clamp tiny floating-point endpoint error.

targets.review_note: Reverse the painting sequence. A last rectangle may erase any currently remaining cells of one target color; already erased cells were overwritten later and impose no restriction. DP over at most16-cell remaining masks tries all one-row and two-row rectangles, deduplicating identical next masks. This captures overlap and overpainting rather than summing independent row stroke counts.
